Each operand is a float[4] in (x, y, z, w) layout with the scalar term at index 3; the result's scalar component a1[3] is a3[3]*a2[3] minus the vector dot product, matching a standard quaternion product. Compute output scalar component: a1[3] = a3[3]*a2[3] - a3[0]*a2[0] - a3[1]*a2[1] - a3[2]*a2[2] (w3*w2 minus the vector dot product).
Return a1, the output quaternion pointer (the this object).
